relationships.subject: Gi DREADD
relationships.evidence_quote: Similarly, Il-1β as a critical mediator of neuropathic pain [73, 74], is also decreased by microglial Gi DREADD activation.

relationships.subject: Gi DREADD
relationships.evidence_quote: SNT-upregulated expression of interferon regulatory factor (IRF) 8, a transcription factor implicated in microglial transition to a reactive state [73], is prevented by Gi DREADD activation.

relationships.subject: Gq DREADD
relationships.evidence_quote: Further analysis showed that Gq DREADD activation led to a significant upregulation of inflammatory mediators (IL-1β, TNFα, CCL3, and CCL4)

relationships.subject: Gi DREADD
relationships.evidence_quote: Microglial Gi DREADD activation can attenuate pro-inflammatory signaling including through the nuclear factor of the kappa light polypeptide gene enhancer in B-cell inhibitor alpha, NLR family pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3), and IL-1β [55].

relationships.subject: Gi DREADD
relationships.evidence_quote: Gi DREADD activation in microglia rapidly reversed allodynia in neuropathic pain conditions.

key_findings: Review: microglial Gi DREADD activation attenuates and Gq DREADD/optogenetic activation induces chronic pain via IL-1β and related mediators
